content_sections.heading: Panjab University Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 2 for Manager (Technology) and 2 for Manager (Finance).

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Panjab University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Panjab University Manager posts?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted through a Walk-in Interview. Therefore, candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date, which is 02 September 2026. There is no separate application deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Manager posts?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Master’s degree in natural or agriculture science/MVSc or a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/Technology or medicine from a recognized University or equivalent, along with 4 years of experience, or a Doctoral degree.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Manager posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Manager posts is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Manager posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Manager posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for Manager posts, with 2 for Manager (Technology) and 2 for Manager (Finance).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to appear directly at the interview venue with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs. Specific documents like ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates are essential.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Walk-in Interview be held?
faq.answer: The official notification should be referred to for the exact venue address for the Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these Manager posts?
faq.answer: The job type for these Manager posts is Contractual.
